description: United States visit visa from Pakistan (USA): requirements, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, common mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: USA visit visa requirements for Pakistanis?
faqs.answer: DS-160, fee, interview, and proof you will return after a temporary visit. SK prepares documents and interview coaching from PKR 30,000.

faqs.question: B1 vs B2?
faqs.answer: B1 covers certain business activities; B2 tourism/family/medical. Many apply combined B1/B2. Purpose must match.

faqs.question: How to pass US visa interview?
faqs.answer: Clear purpose, consistent DS-160, and strong Pakistan ties. We run mock interviews — officers still decide.

faqs.question: Do I need an invitation letter for USA?
faqs.answer: Helpful for family visits but not a substitute for your own ties and funds.

faqs.question: After refusal, can I reapply?
faqs.answer: Yes when circumstances improve. Reapply with corrected issues — not the same weak file.

faqs.question: SK guarantee USA visa?
faqs.answer: Never. US consular officers decide under US law.

United States visit visa from Pakistan

SK Immigration Services helps Pakistani applicants prepare United States visit visa files for tourism, family, medical, business (B1 activities). Embassies decide outcomes — we prepare complete, honest applications.

Who this page is for

Candidates searching for United States visit visa requirements from Pakistan, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, refusal reasons and how to apply — with SK Immigration as their consultant in Rawalpindi.

Requirements

  • Valid passport and DS-160 confirmation
  • MRV fee payment and appointment
  • Evidence of strong social/economic ties to Pakistan
  • Trip purpose explanation for interview
  • Funds and/or sponsor affidavit when relevant
  • Previous US/travel history honesty

Process — how to apply

  1. Eligibility and refusal-risk review
  2. DS-160 accuracy check
  3. Document binder for interview day
  4. Mock interview coaching
  5. Appointment logistics

Documents checklist

  • Passport, DS-160, appointment letter
  • Bank and income proof
  • Employment letter / business registration
  • Property and family documents
  • Invitation if visiting relatives
  • Travel itinerary

Fees

SK from PKR 30,000. MRV and VAC fees separate (non-refundable).

Processing time / timeline

Appointment wait times vary widely; prepare documents before locking a date.

Common mistakes & refusal risks

  • DS-160 errors or omissions
  • Memorized unnatural interview answers
  • Hiding previous refusals
  • Weak ties / immigrant intent signals
  • Paying agents who promise “guaranteed B1/B2”

Related services

All visit visas · Work permits · Visa appointments · Study visas · Free consultation

USA B1/B2 from Pakistan — interview logic

US visitor visas are decided largely at the interview at the US Embassy Islamabad or Consulate Karachi. Officers test whether you are a genuine temporary visitor with a residence abroad you will not abandon.

Where Pakistanis apply (USA)

DS-160 online, visa fee (MRV), then appointment via the official US visa scheduling portal. Biometrics and interview at Islamabad or Karachi per appointment letter — never through unofficial “slot sellers”.

DS-160 consistency checklist

  • Names, employers and travel history match passport and CV
  • Social media / contact fields filled carefully (as required)
  • Do not memorize scripts — understand your own file
  • Never coach false answers; refusals under immigration law are serious

Practice interview themes

  • What is your job and monthly income?
  • Who is paying for this trip?
  • How long will you stay and why that duration?
  • What ties do you have in Pakistan?
  • Have you been refused a visa before?

B1 vs B2 vs study/work

B1 is business visitor activity; B2 is tourism/family. Neither is a work permit or student visa. See USA study or work guidance for other categories.

SK Immigration support

Visit packaging from PKR 30,000: document review, DS-160 coaching, interview prep. Consulate decides. B1/B2 answer · official US links · USA appointments.

Cover letter outline (USA visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for USA cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
